gaps.sentence: Drive ___ (CARE) — the mountain road has hairpin bends.
gaps.explanation: An adverb is needed to modify 'drive': carefully.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (ARRIVE) of the delegation was delayed by the storm.
He was ___ (COURAGE) enough to speak first.
___ (PERSIST) rain ruined the first two days of the festival.
gaps.explanation: An adjective is needed before 'rain': persistent; 'persistence' is the noun.
'The wind strengthened' — the verb from STRONG.

gaps.sentence: The new ___ (GOVERN) takes office in May.
The castle is ___ (SIGHT) for miles in every direction.
gaps.explanation: 'Be visible' = can be seen; 'visibility' is the noun for how far you can see.
